Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE polished production-feasible mobile landscape game UI redesign concept, aspect ratio 2.23:1, matching the attached Chinese cozy fantasy game screenshots. Inputs are layout problem references and exact established art/style references, NOT instructions to reproduce the old layout. Preserve the actual warm wood desk, the SAME original left drawer with cream embroidered cloth, wooden tray, dried rose/lavender cluster, vertical parchment category tabs, and pale taupe scrollwork corner letter-paper art. Remove all red annotations, platform black/green testing watermark, capsule menu, device frame.
CRITICAL NEW LAYOUT: drawer touches the EXTREME LEFT screen edge at x=0, full height, no wood gap to its left. It occupies roughly 25% of screen. Small subtle cream title tab '词条' about half the old title area. No scrolling or scrollbar anywhere in tray. Five neatly sized word scraps and a compact bottom pager '‹   1 / 3   ›' above the dried flowers; right-side paper category tabs remain. Paper scraps closely fit text length, same short height; no oversized blank strips.
The LETTER PAPER IS THE DOMINANT WORK AREA: begins immediately after drawer at x=26%, from y=11% to y=97%, fills almost ALL remaining right area to x=99%. Landscape paper with preserved small ornaments in four corners, generous blank writing surface, NO broad unused wood margins, NO bottom control bar. Do NOT keep the small centered 4:3 postcard in inputs. Paper should be about 72% screen width and 85% screen height. On paper centered near its top '我想……'. A restrained collage of original paper word slips '去看看' '日出日落' '四季流转' with small botanical cutouts. One selected word slip '日出日落' with light thin selection rectangle. A compact FLOATING four-action cream toolbox immediately ABOVE this selected slip, locally attached to the slip, labels EXACTLY '下一层' '上一层' '锁定' '收回'. Toolbox only 25% of paper width, readable thumb-sized actions. Large accessible rotate handle outside top-right of selection (curved arrow icon), diagonal scale handle at lower-right; clearly separated from word and toolbox. No left/right rotation or plus/minus scale buttons.
GLOBAL controls only a single row at TOP CENTER of remaining area above paper: small secondary buttons '撤销' and '暂回首页', primary dark navy gold botanical button '预览并寄出'. Restrained small title '愿望拼贴' near paper upper left / header left, NOT huge heading consuming space. This is an actual art-directed UI reference screen, not a poster or presentation. Typography elegant dark brown Chinese calligraphic print on cream, buttons from existing gold floral/navy family. Sharp legible Chinese text. Keep the entire width used. No explanatory callouts or extra toolbars.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE polished actual game UI reference, 2.23:1 mobile landscape. Attached images show the existing art style and problems, use their exact cozy wood workshop, original cream floral cloth LEFT tray, wooden tray, dried roses and lavender, gold navy botanical buttons, parchment letter surfaces. Do not replace the tray with generic new UI. No device frame, no red annotations, no platform watermark/capsule.
NEW layout: original drawer FLUSH to absolute LEFT EDGE x=0 full-height taking 25% width. Tiny '词条' heading at upper left of tray, reduced title label/background. Original vertical parchment category tabs on its right. Word cards compact and close fitting to actual word lengths: '困' a small short slip, '合上眼' a moderately wider slip, '梦见' a short slip. ALL SAME PAPER HEIGHT and vertically centered text; chosen-role indicator a very small round '主' or '辅' seal overlay on outer corner which does NOT reserve an extra row and DOES NOT change card height. No scrolling or scrollbar in tray; bottom accessible left/right gold arrows with '1 / 2', above flower cluster. Show selection words in an orderly two-column layout where possible.
Right area: top slim warm wooden HUD and a narrow request strip ('埃利亚斯·沃德' and a short request), background stove/cauldron visible in upper region. User has tapped '条件与药效'. A LARGE READABLE PARCHMENT BOTTOM SHEET slides up from the BOTTOM of the right workspace, starting around y=32% to y=98%, spanning x=27% to x=99%. It overlays/covers recipe slots and ingredient shelf; DOES NOT squash or reflow those controls and does NOT cover tray. Background behind bottom sheet subtly dim. Top of sheet '药性手札' on left, status '已满足' and a small close X on right. Large clear comfortable body:
'主导药性 · 睡眠（强烈）'
'炼制条件'
'主词：困    辅词：梦见    原料：干花瓣'
'可能药效'
'又见到了母亲'
Use two readable sections with ample line height and subtle separators, not tiny dense text or a short thin horizontal panel. Bottom sheet uses existing parchment art with modest corner botanicals, clearly a game panel rather than a modern SaaS card. A small '查看数值' secondary action can sit at bottom right; no full-width fixed extra toolbar. This is an implementation-ready concept preserving existing textures; full width landscape framing. No white outer margins, no arbitrary new features.

Use case ui-mockup. Create a high-quality coherent mobile landscape Chinese fantasy game UI REFERENCE, 2.23:1. Use attached actual title screenshot as the exact background/style source: inside cozy magic shop wooden door on left, open doorway to sunset lakeside harbor village center, shelves with flowers and potion bottles on right. Retain this particular background, warm amber and twilight blue mood and soft focus. No device frame, no platform capsule/watermark. This is a new title screen layout with a CURRENT-PLAYTHROUGH REWIND panel OPEN.
Left 28%: slightly restrained title '寄往人间', tiny subtitle 'TO THE HUMAN WORLD', vertical menu in cream calligraphic text: '继续游戏', '进度回溯', '旅途留念', '新的旅程'. Highlight '进度回溯' with tiny gold diamond. Preserve existing airy text menu style, not huge boxed navigation.
Right 65%: large elegant cream parchment panel floating over the harbor scene, four subtly ornamental corners, dark brown type, tasteful small navy gold buttons. Footer compact secondary '取消', prominent primary dark navy floral-gold '回到第 3 天'. Small subdued caption '仅可回到本轮已到达的日期'. Panel uses height from y=15% to y=90%, no huge empty panel area, timeline and selected detail should be readable with a phone held landscape. This is a visual design concept, not code. Sharp Chinese text. No extra marketing slogans.

Use case ui-mockup. ONE redesigned game interface concept, landscape 2.23:1 mobile framing. Preserve this established art; remove all red markings, platform watermark/capsule and device framing.

'昨晚又梦见娘在旧桌子旁补衣裳。'
'我坐在旁边帮她牵着线，她嫌我扯得太紧，伸手在我手背上轻拍了一下。我松了松手，她就接着缝，针尖从磨薄的布里穿过去，又快又密。'
Comfortable line wrapping across broad panel, avoid shrinking text just to fit. A slim scroll indicator belongs ONLY to main letter reading region if needed. Bottom two elegant existing botanical buttons on same baseline: smaller cream '重新调配', larger navy gold '确认发货'. Keep header and actions compact so the letter itself receives most space. No unnecessary author/role duplicates, no giant margins over or under paper, no modern rounded dashboard cards, no added story prose.

Full sheet 1900x2550 approximate, each panel identical size, separated by a thin 8px dark rule. These are three real game screens, not decorative postcards with large outer margins. Inputs establish exact cozy illustrated Chinese fantasy game's art and ending typography. No mock phone frames, no red annotations, no platform watermark/capsule, no explanatory headings outside screens.
Panel TOP: retain original quiet dusk boat/harbor backdrop from image1, dimmed almost navy black. At EXACT PHYSICAL screen horizontal center, elegant cream title '旅人', below '人间单程船票', below an airy line-and-small-diamond return button '返回首页'. All three centered on the SAME x=50% axis. Composition block sits around central y=47% of this panel, button y=65%, balanced top/bottom, no left inset or asymmetric safe-area shift.
Panel MIDDLE: cozy dim workshop interior from image2 ambiance, not external harbor view, warm dark brown; EXACT SAME centered typography position, scale and spacings as top. Title '学徒', subtitle '留下来的人', line-and-diamond button '返回首页'. No large letter sheet here, this is the terminal screen after reading the letter.

Edit the attached mobile landscape game UI CONCEPT with TWO targeted tray fixes only; preserve the large readable bottom-emerging '药性手札' parchment sheet, all text, workshop background, top request strip, typography, palette and existing fullheight left cloth/wood tray at x=0, flowers and bottom pager.
